Priya (Partnerships): Quick check-in: where do we stand on marketplace gating for H100 / H200-B200 / MI300 / Gaudi? Need short notes for partner comms + any embargo windows.
Maya (Eng-Platform): H100: image + perf tests green but registry size ~4.6GB; slimming PR opened. H200/B200: int8 paths validated, slight perf variance. MI300: firmware signoff pending vendor; ROCm dependency noted. Gaudi: manifest fix required for device routing.
Jonah (Product): Proposed announce cadence: avoid NV event on 1791300000. Suggest MI300 then H100, H200/B200 staggered. Embargo: request 7-14 day vendor notification.
Lina (Field/Sales): Field needs 10 business days pre-announce enablement + one-pager and migration notes for Dedicated. Please drop doc links when available.
Samir (SI Liaison): SI dry-run ask: schedule Gaudi + MI300 smoke on 1791280000. Need VPC test creds and `svc-marketplace-int`. I'll publish runbook PR with checklist by EOD.
partner-bot: Reminder: Legal requires 72h written notice for embargo changes. See https://docs.redwood/legal/vendor-embargo-guidelines
Maya (Eng-Platform): Action: will post PRs for H100 slimming and Gaudi manifest fix today; will also attach CI logs. If mem pressure recurs, workaround = toggle vm.nr_hugepages on staging nodes.
Priya (Partnerships): Thanks team. Action items: Maya post PRs + logs, Samir schedule SI dry-run + PR, Jonah finalize cadence for vendor comms, Lina draft sales stub once PRs land. Will send consolidated partner update after runbook lands. :white_check_mark:
